title: Atlas — microbenchmark-chainedhotstuff
description: make microbenchmark-chainedhotstuff local — Chained HotStuff. Panels are generated against the metrics this suite actually emits; see the 'About this suite' note for what its metric level leaves out.

list.name: host
list.label: Node
list.description: Atlas tags every point with host=NodeId(n): replicas are 0..n-1, clients start at 1000. Keep multi/includeAll on — the values contain parentheses, and Grafana only regex-escapes multi-value variables.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: The `extra` tag: 'None' unless the run set INFLUX_EXTRA. Suites share one database and several measurement names, so filter by Run before comparing anything across protocols.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description:
Mean across replicas. Every replica handles every operation, so the mean is cluster throughput — a sum would multiply it by n.

Measured at the executor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "OPERATIONS_EXECUTED_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Client request rate
panels.description: Summed over client processes — each drives a disjoint slice of the load, so here the sum is the real total.

targets.query: SELECT sum("rate") FROM (SELECT mean("value") AS "rate" FROM "CLIENT_RQ_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Client latency
panels.description: End-to-end at the client: send → f+1 matching replies.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Consensus wait
panels.description: Pre-prepare → handed to the executor. Roughly a consensus round trip for a standard executor, near zero for a preemptive one.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "CONSENSUS_WAIT_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

options.content:
**make microbenchmark-chainedhotstuff local** — Chained HotStuff, replica metrics at `MetricLevel::Debug`, clients at `MetricLevel::Info`.

Chained HotStuff (hot-iron-oxide `src/chained/`): one pipelined generic phase instead of four, so there is no phase ladder — the protocol row is the vote/proposal round trip (VOTE_SEND → VOTE_RECEIVED → PROPOSAL_SEND) plus END_TO_END_LATENCY.

The four-phase metrics are registered by the same crate and stay empty here; that is expected. Note the two roles measure different things: VOTE_SEND_LATENCY is recorded by every replica, VOTE_RECEIVED / PROPOSAL_SEND only by the leader of that height, so expect those series on one node at a time.

---
**Registered but not emitted here** (16). This suite passes these crates' `metrics()` to `initialize_metrics`, but `with_metric_level(MetricLevel::Debug)` filters them out, so no panel below draws them — raise the level in the binary if you need one:

`CLIENT_POOL_SLEEP_TIME` (Trace), `CLIENT_RQ_SEND_TIME` (Trace), `DECISION_LOG_WORK_DELIVER_TIME` (Trace), `DECISION_LOG_WORK_QUEUE_SIZE` (Trace), `MESSAGES_IN_CHANNEL` (Trace), `MESSAGE_DELIVER_TIME` (Trace), `MESSAGE_DISPATCH_TIME` (Trace), `MESSAGE_WAKER_TIME` (Trace), `ORDERING_PROTOCOL_POLL_TIME` (Trace), `REPLICA_INTERNAL_PROCESS_TIME` (Trace), `REPLICA_ORDERED_RQS_PROCESSED` (Trace), `REPLICA_RQ_QUEUE_SIZE` (Trace), `REPLICA_TAKE_FROM_NETWORK` (Trace), `REQUEST_SEND_TIME` (Trace), `RQ_BATCH_TRACKING` (Disabled), `RQ_CLIENT_TRACKING` (Disabled)

panels.title: Chained HotStuff — pipelined round
panels.description: hot-iron-oxide src/chained/: one generic phase per height, pipelined, so there is no four-phase ladder to plot. Note the roles differ — VOTE_SEND_LATENCY is recorded by every replica, while VOTE_RECEIVED and PROPOSAL_SEND are recorded only by the leader for that height, so expect them on one node at a time.

panels.title: Round trip
panels.description: END_TO_END_LATENCY spans several pipelined heights, so it is legitimately much larger than the sum of the other three.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "VOTE_SEND_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "VOTE_RECEIVED_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "PROPOSAL_SEND_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "END_TO_END_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "SIGNATURE_PROPOSAL_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "SIGNATURE_VOTE_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Execution (standard executor)
panels.description: atlas-smr-execution: the baseline, which waits for the commit before touching application state.

panels.title: Execution timings
panels.description: EXECUTION_LATENCY is queue-to-execute; EXECUTION_TIME_TAKEN is the application itself. On a null-application suite the second should be near zero.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "EXECUTION_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "EXECUTION_TIME_TAKEN" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "UNORDERED_EXECUTION_TIME_TAKEN" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "REPLIES_PASSING_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "REPLY_SENT_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "OPERATIONS_EXECUTED_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "UNORDERED_OPERATIONS_EXECUTED_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Client-observed behaviour
panels.description: What the load generator sees. The only view that is not the system marking its own homework — if these and the replica-side numbers disagree, believe these.

panels.title: Client request rate
panels.description: One series per client container (NodeId 1000+), each aggregating N_CLIENTS logical clients. Counter metrics are reset every collection, so a point is already a per-second rate.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_RECV_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Client request latency
panels.description: Ordered latency is send → f+1 matching replies. CLIENT_RQ_SEND_TIME is registered at Trace, so it only appears in suites whose client runs at that level.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_UNORDERED_RQ_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_DELIVER_RESPONSE" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_RECV_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Client timeouts
panels.description: Non-zero means requests are not completing on the first attempt. Sustained timeouts on the replica side precede a view change.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_TIMEOUT" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Request pre-processing
panels.description: atlas-smr-core: the path from a client message arriving to a request being proposable. Where load sheds before consensus ever sees it.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_CLIENT_MSGS" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_WORKER_ORDERED_PROCESS" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_WORKER_DECIDED_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_ORCHESTRATOR_WORKER_PASSING_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_WORKER_PROPOSER_PASSING_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_COLLECT_PENDING" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_CLONE_RQS" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_FWD_RQS" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT_RQS" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_DECIDED_RQS" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_WORKER_STOPPED_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_CLONE_PENDING_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_COLLECT_PENDING_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Pre-processing rates and batch size
panels.description: Mixed units by design: the discard rate only means something next to the intake rate. RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_BATCH_SIZE is a Count — averaged, never summed.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_CLIENT_COUNT" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESS_ORCHESTRATOR_MESSAGES_PROCESSED" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_WORKER_ORDERED_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_DISCARDED_REQUESTS" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RQ_PRE_PROCESSING_BATCH_SIZE" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Replica loop
panels.description: atlas-smr-replica: the main loop that polls the ordering protocol, feeds the decision log and drains timeouts. Several of these are Trace-only.

panels.title: Loop timings
panels.description: Poll time climbing while process time stays flat means the replica is idle on the network rather than compute-bound.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "ORDERING_PROTOCOL_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "REPLICA_PROTOCOL_RESP_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RUN_LATENCY_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "DECISION_LOG_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "OP_MESSAGES_PROCESSED" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "DL_MESSAGES_PROCESSED" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "UNORDERED_OPS_PUSHED" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Timeouts
panels.description: Counts and durations share the axis; the shape is what matters — any sustained rise here is the run leaving the happy path.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "TIMEOUT_RECEIVED_COUNT" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "TIMEOUT_MESSAGES_PROCESSED" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "TIMEOUT_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "TIMEOUT_MESSAGE_PROCESSING" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Communication
panels.description: atlas-communication and atlas-comm-mio. Signing cost scales with batch size, so read this row next to the protocol's batch panel before blaming the network.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "COMM_SERIALIZE_AND_SIGN_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "COMM_DESERIALIZE_AND_VERIFY_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "THREADPOOL_PASS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_POOL_COLLECT_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_POOL_BATCH_PASSING_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "TIME_SPENT_CLIENT_POOL" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Message sizes
panels.description: CountMax: each point is the largest message in that window, not an average.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "OUTGOING_MESSAGE_SIZE" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "INCOMING_MESSAGE_SIZE" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Logging, checkpointing and transfer
panels.description: Durable log and the three transfer protocols. Spikes here that line up with throughput dips are the usual explanation for a periodic sawtooth.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "APP_STATE_DIGEST_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Transfer protocols
panels.description: Note LT_STATE_CLONE_TIME is registered by both atlas-log-transfer and febft-state-transfer, so a single series can carry both crates' samples.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "LT_STATE_CLONE_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "LT_PROOFS_CLONE_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "STATE_TRANSFER_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "VT_MSG_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Host resources
panels.description: Written by the Atlas-Metrics OS thread every 250 ms. These bypass the metric registry and the level filter, so they are present in every suite.

panels.title: CPU per node
panels.description: Averaged over cores: OS_CPU_USER is written once per core (tag `cpu`) as a 0..1 fraction.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "OS_CPU_USER" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Process RSS per node
panels.description: Resident memory of the Atlas process, not the whole host.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "OS_RAM_USAGE" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Network per node
panels.description:
Bytes between 250 ms samples, scaled x4 to a per-second rate.

Caveat: os_mon.rs crosses the directions — OS_NETWORK_UP is summed from received() and OS_NETWORK_DOWN from transmitted(). Trust the series names.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") * 4 FROM "OS_NETWORK_UP" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") * 4 FROM "OS_NETWORK_DOWN" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
